section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种基于生物基因工程的微生物培养箱具，包括箱体，箱体的左右侧表面靠上中间位置开设有散热口，箱体的前侧表面靠上右侧位置固定安装有电源开关，箱体的前侧表面靠上位置固定安装有控制面板，箱体的前侧表面右侧靠上位置转动安装有箱门一，箱体的内部左右侧表面靠上位置固定安装有滑轨，滑轨的上表面滑动安装有放置板一，箱体的前侧表面靠右侧位置转动安装有箱门二，箱体的内表面底部转动安装有转轴，转轴的外侧表面中间和靠上位置固定安装有放置板二，转轴的下端固定安装有齿轮一，箱体的左侧表面中间靠下位置固定安装有电机。通过设置的多个滑轨和烧杯架以及培养皿，使得整个装置能够满足同时进行多组试验。

The utility model discloses a microbial incubator based on biological genetic engineering, which comprises a case body, wherein a heat radiating port is formed in the middle position of the left side surface and the right side surface of the case body close to the upper right side position, a power switch is fixedly installed on the front side surface of the case body close to the upper right side position, a control panel is fixedly installed on the front side surface of the case body close to the upper position, a first case door is rotatably installed on the right side surface of the front side surface of the case body close to the upper position, a slide rail is fixedly installed on the left side surface and the right side surface inside the case body close to the upper position, a first placing plate is slidably installed on the upper surface of the slide rail, a second case door is rotatably installed on the front side surface of the case body close to the right side position, a rotating shaft is rotatably installed at the bottom of the inner surface of the case body, a second placing plate is fixedly installed in the middle position and close to the upper position of the outer side surface of the rotating shaft, a first gear is fixedly installed at the lower end of the rotating shaft, and a motor is fixedly installed in the middle position of the left side surface of the case body. Through a plurality of slide rails and beaker frame and the culture dish that set up for whole device can satisfy and carry out the multiunit simultaneously and test.

Microbial cultivation case utensil based on biological genetic engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering, and particularly relates to a microbial incubator based on biological genetic engineering.

Background

Genetic engineering (also known as gene splicing technology and DNA recombination technology) is a genetic technology which is based on molecular genetics as a theoretical basis and takes modern methods of molecular biology and microbiology as means to construct hybrid DNA molecules in vitro from genes from different sources according to a pre-designed blueprint and then introduce the hybrid DNA molecules into living cells so as to change the original genetic characteristics of organisms, obtain new varieties and produce new products. The gene engineering technology provides a powerful means for the research of the structure and the function of the gene.

In biological genetic engineering, the incubator is required to be used for culturing the microorganisms required to be tested, but the existing microorganism incubator can only meet the single test requirement, so that a plurality of groups of tests are inconvenient to carry out simultaneously, and the culture of the microorganisms is easily influenced by the vibration of the incubator.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Aiming at the defects in the prior art, the utility model aims to provide a microbial incubator based on biological genetic engineering, which solves the problems that the existing microbial incubator can only meet the requirement of a single test, is inconvenient to carry out multiple groups of tests simultaneously, and the culture of microorganisms is easily influenced by the vibration of the incubator.

In order to achieve the purpose, the utility model provides the following technical scheme: a microorganism incubator based on biological gene engineering comprises a case body, wherein a heat radiation port is arranged at the upper middle position of the left side surface and the right side surface of the case body, a power switch is fixedly arranged at the upper right side position of the front side surface of the box body, a control panel is fixedly arranged at the upper position of the front side surface of the box body, a first box door is rotatably arranged at the upper position on the right side of the front side surface of the box body, a slide rail is fixedly arranged at the upper position on the left and right side surfaces in the box body, a first placing plate is arranged on the upper surface of the slide rail in a sliding manner, a second box door is rotatably arranged at the position close to the right side of the front side surface of the box body, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged at the bottom of the inner surface of the box body, a placing plate II is fixedly arranged in the middle and close to the upper position of the outer side surface of the rotating shaft, the lower end of the rotating shaft is fixedly provided with a first gear, and the middle of the left side surface of the box body is fixedly provided with a motor at a lower position.

Preferably, ten are no less than to the quantity of thermovent, be symmetrical parallel structure distribution between the thermovent and lean on the upper position at the left and right sides surface of box, there is ventilation unit left side surface intermediate position of box through bolt fixed mounting.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the advantage lies in, through thermovent and the ventilation unit who sets up for the ventilation cooling effect of whole device is better, avoids appearing the equipment damage that the high temperature caused.

Preferably, the first box door and the box body form a rotating structure, the four sliding rails are symmetrically arranged, and the first placing plate forms a slidable adjusting structure through the sliding rails.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the advantage lies in, through a plurality of slide rails that set up for can prevent a plurality of boards of placing on the slide rail one, be convenient for carry out the multiunit simultaneously experimental.

Preferably, the second box door and the second box body form a rotating structure, the rotating shaft and the second box body form a rotating structure, the two placing plates are arranged, the upper surface of the two placing plates is fixedly provided with a beaker frame, and a culture dish is movably arranged in the beaker frame.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the advantage lies in, a plurality of beaker frame and culture dish through being equipped with on the surface of placing board two for this device can satisfy and carry out the multiunit simultaneously and test.

Preferably, the number of the rack and the number of the culture dish are eight, and the rack and the culture dish form a rotating structure with the box body through a rotating shaft.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the advantage lies in, through the pivot that sets up for rack two can rotate and adjust, thereby realizes rotating the regulation to beaker frame and culture dish, is convenient for get to the culture dish and takes and place.

Preferably, the output end of the motor is fixedly provided with a second gear, a transmission chain is connected between the second gear and the first gear, the second gear forms a rotating structure through the motor, and the first gear forms a rotating structure through the transmission chain.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the advantage lies in, rotates through the motor that sets up and drives gear two and rotate, and under drive chain's effect, gear two drives gear one and rotates to the control pivot rotates.

Preferably, the lower fixed surface of box installs the spring, the spring is provided with four, be symmetrical structure fixed mounting in the lower surface four corners position of box between the spring, the lower fixed surface of spring installs the bottom plate.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the advantage lies in, through the spring that sets up for whole device has better stability, and the vibration that produces when avoiding the device operation leads to the fact the damage to inside microorganism culture dish, brings adverse effect for the experiment.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the beneficial effects that:

1. the two placing plates I can be placed on the sliding rails at the same time through the four symmetrical sliding rails arranged at the upper positions inside the box body, so that multiple groups of experiments can be performed at the same time, and the placing plates II arranged on the rotating shaft are provided with a plurality of beaker holders and culture dishes, so that the culture dishes can be conveniently taken and stored while the multiple groups of experiments are performed at the same time;

2. through the spring that is equipped with in the lower surface four corners position of box for the case utensil can carry out the elastic adjustment under the effect of spring, avoids because of the device operation, and produced vibration causes the influence to microorganism in the culture dish.
